laws.rule: Since 1 April 2026 Hokkaido charges an accommodation tax per person per night: JPY 100 under JPY 20,000, JPY 200 from JPY 20,000 to 49,999, JPY 500 from JPY 50,000 (about A$0.90 to about A$4.51, RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Sapporo, Otaru, Niseko, Kutchan, Hakodate, Furano and other towns add their own tax on top (Kutchan charges a flat 3% including the prefectural share). Paid to the accommodation.
